title: Low-Glycemic French Choux Gougere
description: A low-glycemic twist on the classic French choux pastry gougere, featuring piccalilli and a smoky flavor. Perfect for a special occasion.

ingredients.name: Almond flour
ingredients.notes: Make sure to use a finely ground almond flour.

ingredients.name: Coconut oil
ingredients.notes: Melt the coconut oil before adding it to the mixture.

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.notes: Make sure the eggs are room temperature before using.

ingredients.name: Grated cheddar cheese
ingredients.notes: Use a low-glycemic cheddar cheese, such as cheddar made from sheep's milk.

ingredients.name: Piccalilli
ingredients.notes: Use a homemade or store-bought piccalilli recipe.

ingredients.name: Smoked paprika
ingredients.notes: Add a smoky flavor to the gougere.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality salt, such as sea salt or Himalayan pink salt.

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: Use freshly ground black pepper for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Chives
ingredients.notes: Chop the chives finely before adding them to the mixture.

ingredients.name: Greek yogurt
ingredients.notes: Use a low-glycemic Greek yogurt, such as sheep's milk yogurt.

ingredients.name: Chickpeas
ingredients.notes: Mash the chickpeas before adding them to the mixture.

ingredients.name: Mozzarella cheese
ingredients.notes: Use a low-glycemic mozzarella cheese, such as buffalo mozzarella.

instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a medium saucepan, combine the almond flour, coconut oil, eggs, grated cheddar cheese, piccalilli, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens and forms a ball.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the chives, Greek yogurt, chickpeas, and mozzarella cheese.
Transfer the mixture to a piping bag fitted with a large round tip.
Pipe the mixture onto the prepared baking sheet, forming small balls.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the gougere are golden brown and puffed.
Allow the gougere to cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes before serving.
